title: Chess, But the Darkness is A̸̩͙͂͊͝l̵̺̋l̷͙̞̫̆̎ͅ-̸͍͍̞̇C̷̑͝o̶̧͔̲̤̔͑̚ǹ̴͘s̷̈̊u̵̳͔͝m̸̾̉i̵̧͔̠̪̊͛n̴͌̎̈́ǵ̸͊͂
summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish with SCP-280-style 'darkness' starting on b4. Each round the darkness expands by one square orthogonally into a square that is not protected (attacked) by any piece; if that square holds a piece, the piece is consumed. Darkness squares are impassable, so a wall of darkness can cut the board in two. The narrator baits the engine into unprotected squares, wins material (the darkness eats a bishop and later the queen), and finally the darkness consumes the black king.
rules: Standard chess otherwise; player White vs Stockfish Black.
Darkness starts as a single square on b4.
After each round the darkness expands one square orthogonally (up/down/left/right of any darkness square) into an UNPROTECTED square, i.e. a square no piece (of either colour) attacks/defends.
A piece does not protect its own square: an occupied square is unprotected unless another piece attacks it ('a piece does not defend itself').
If the darkness expands onto a piece, that piece is consumed (removed). If it consumes a king, that side loses.
Darkness squares are permanently blocked: no piece can move onto or through them.
Choice among candidate squares: uniformly random (iwantcheckmate.com/challenges/dark page script, 2026-11-26); the video never shows a choice that contradicts it (4:20 'nowhere else to expand into').
If no unprotected orthogonal square exists, the darkness does not expand that turn.
A consumed king ends the game like a mate (site); stalemate is a draw (site; video 5:22 'if the engine runs out of moves' is about the king being boxed in, not stalemate rules).

The engine plays plain chess and does not account for the darkness (site: Fairy-Stockfish 'chess' variant restricted to legal moves; video: the narrator baits it into unprotected squares, Bc5 / Qd5 / Ke7).
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish, or have the darkness consume the black king (how the video's game ended).

custom_pieces.name: The Darkness (SCP-280)

setup: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1 with darkness on b4.
events: Every round after Black moves: darkness expands 1 orthogonal unprotected square; consumes a piece there.
visual_fx: Darkness = black tiles with a fuzzy speckled rim drawn ~3.9% larger than the square, so neighbours merge into one blob (site dark-fuzz.png; video frame 3:10)
Two glowing white eyes stay on the ORIGIN square b4 all game (site .darkTile.origin; video frame 3:10: darkness a4 b4 b5, eyes on b4)
A new darkness square fades in over 200 ms linear (site @keyframes darkGrowth); no flash, no candidate markers
Consumed piece: plain capture sound, piece gone at once; consumed king: confetti burst on its square (site finish())
Pink squares/arrows in the video are the narrator's right-click annotations, not mode visuals
